description: A pull request whose own tests pass but which fails its story's first criterion: total/1 subtracts, so total([2, 3]) is 1. The verdict must be reject.

story.title: Add TinyApp.total/1 for upload sizes
story.description: The uploads page needs the total size of a list of uploads, in bytes.
test_cases: total of two sizes is their sum
total of an empty list is zero

expectations.rubric: The finding names the first criterion and the subtraction in total/1, and the missing two-size test.
